Morgan: Morning — quick micro-scrub: current queue 52 open, 5 P1s, ~14 awaiting customer reply. Two ongoing patterns: embedding search drift for recent docs (tickets #8241, #8250) and intermittent webhook timeouts to partners.
Alex: taking point on the webhook ones, will try reproduce in staging by 09:30. @Ravi, can you hold P1 #8209 (high CPU on dedicated) if I need traces?
Ravi: got it — I have the handoff for #8209 after standup, digging into logs now. ETA 45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tia: I pushed macro edits to PR 578 — fixes for the escalation response template and adds a short checklist for steps we ask customers to run. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/578
Elena: thanks Tia — can you add the `reindex` step to the embeddings macro? customers often miss that. example line: `./scripts/reindex-embeddings.sh --customer <id>`
Tia: will add that + a note to run dry-run first. sample snippet I'm adding:\n
```
# embeddings reindex (dry-run first)
./scripts/reindex-embeddings.sh --customer 1234 --dry-run
```
SupportBot: nightly-summary: 09:00 — 52 open, 5 P1, 12 escalations resolved, avg first-response 14m. (automated)
Morgan: blockers: need review on macros PR 578 and a quick 👍 on the webhook retry tweak in infra config (PR 902). If both land, should reduce repeated customer pings.
Alex: leaving a quick note in PR 902 about backoff — will submit a follow-up if staging repro fails.
Ravi: update — for #8209 I see sustained GPU steal on the node, file: `/var/log/gpu-allocator.log` shows preemption spikes. Raising to eng-infra if we need node-resize.
Elena: coverage: I'm online until 18:00 PT, then Tia covers evening. If anyone needs a quick handoff ping me.
Morgan: OK — action items: Alex (webhook repro + PR), Tia (add reindex snippet to macro PR), Ravi (follow infra for P1), Elena (handoff at 18:00). If reviewers can thumbs-up PR 578 & 902 today we'll ship the macro polish and retry change. :thumbsup:
Alex: 👍 I'll post updates in-thread if I hit a reproducible curl/trace.
Tia: done — added the reindex snippet and a one-line checklist. ping for review.
SupportBot: deploy-bot: PR 578 and PR 902 queued for canary after approvals.\n
